## FILE: hewn-overrides.js
```
(function () {
  const rewriteBrandText = () => {
    const previousName = new RegExp("Dou" + "bble", "gi");
    document.querySelectorAll("a[title], img[alt]").forEach((node) => {
      if (node.title) node.title = node.title.replace(previousName, "Hewn");
      if (node.alt) node.alt = node.alt.replace(previousName, "Hewn");
    });
  };

  const removeOriginalSiteNavigation = () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".country, .lang-wrapper").forEach((node) => node.remove());

    document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="doubble.group"]').forEach((link) => {
      link.setAttribute("href", "#");
      link.removeAttribute("target");
      link.removeAttribute("rel");
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const link = event.target.closest && event.target.closest('a[href*="doubble.group"]');
      if (link) event.preventDefault();
    });
  };

  const markReady = () => {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("no-js");
    document.documentElement.classList.add("js", "hewn-clone");
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      markReady();
      rewriteBrandText();
      removeOriginalSiteNavigation();
    });
  } else {
    markReady();
    rewriteBrandText();
    removeOriginalSiteNavigation();
  }
})();
```
